pre_command: osascript -e 'tell application "Anaconda-Navigator" to quit'; sleep 2 && { pkill jupyter || true; } && rm -f ~/Desktop/Data_Exploration.ipynb
instruction: Launch Jupyter Notebook from Anaconda Navigator and create a new notebook titled 'Data_Exploration.ipynb' on my Desktop.
evaluator: [ -s ~/Documents/Data_Exploration.ipynb ] && pgrep -f jupyter >/dev/null && echo True || echo False
